title: The blob uprising
summary: Two blobs plot to take over Frosthollow. One of them is sweet on Ingrid, and the yeti is in the way.

mr-blob-a.about: The schemer. Grins a lot, talks big, agrees to anything that keeps the plan going.

mr-blob-b.about: The worrier. Nervous, honest, and sweet on Ingrid.

ingrid.about: Frosthollow's warm-hearted resident. Adores the blobs and has no idea what they're up to.

yeti.about: Big, loud, and the reason the blobs haven't tried anything yet.

beats.note: The player's first visit to Frosthollow: they overhear the blobs.
Talking to Ingrid afterwards: once she goes into the inn, the blobs ask the player to join them. The player picks join, refuse or tell (threaten to tell Ingrid).
